create_WindowedRunningMean_finite: create a WindowedRunningMean with a fixed window size of 100 to track recent values
create_WindowedRunningMean_infinite: create a WindowedRunningMean with an infinite window to track all values added over time
add_values_to_WindowedRunningMean: add individual float values to a WindowedRunningMean instance using the add method
add_many_values_to_WindowedRunningMean: add a sequence of values to a WindowedRunningMean using the add_many method
query_WindowedRunningMean_mean: query the current running mean, sum, and count from a WindowedRunningMean instance
